narrative.headline: The Hurricanes lead the power rankings
narrative.blurb: 47 games on this week's slate. The Hurricanes are No. 1 at 16-3-2 with a +40 goal differential. The East's last playoff spot is the Panthers on 27 points. The West's last spot is the Mammoth on 23 points. The Hurricanes lead the heat check at 3-0-0 and +14 goals over the last three games.
